title: Chapter 1604 - 672: This Battle, I Win!
content:
Chapter 1604: Chapter 672: This Battle, I Win!

On the side of Nanming Village, a look of surprise flashed in Tan Zhu’s eyes.

He realized: "Liang Ming can’t rely solely on himself to display this kind of Divine Skills. But he combined his Main Cultivation Method with the power of seven Underworld Gods to create these Divine Skills. Calling himself a True Monarch is quite fitting."

"These Divine Skills are tough to combat, and now Chun Yangzi is in danger."

The seven tombs resonated simultaneously.

The Bone-carrying Child crouched on the first tomb, where the sound of cracking bones in his arms transformed into a black and yellow Flesh Body Jade.

The Light-Hiding Tomb Woman stood before the second tomb, her white mourning clothes turned scorched and curled by Yang Fire. In her hands, she held the Broken Lamp, with the last wisp of black light within transforming into a Magic Power Jade.

The Old Official Furi flipped through the Fragmented Volume, using a broken pen dipped in black blood to inscribe peculiar Talismans in front of the third tomb, forming a Golden Core Jade.

The Grey Fetus Corpse Mother kneeled beside the fourth tomb, her massive abdomen split open, and a tide of grey fetal membrane spread out, enclosing the Life Span Jade.

The Erosion Mirror Nether Official stood atop the fifth tomb, with a shattered mirror on his chest reflecting Chun Yangzi’s face, secretly harboring the Dao Heart Jade.

The Earth Belly Fire Swallowing Lord’s shattered abdomen roared as it hugged the Divine Soul Jade with its remaining half-arm.

At last, the Burial Sun Jade Lord personally presided over the Destiny Jade!

The seven jades resonated in unison.

Black and yellow radiance rose from the seven Yin Tombs, converging above Chun Yangzi’s head.

A vast, chilling aura of death, in an instant, suppressed the Dawu Sky Platform!

Black and yellow jade marks appeared on Chun Yangzi’s body.

Those jade marks seemed to sear into his skin like a brand. As soon as they appeared, his heart chilled, as if ice filled his chest, and he felt as though he was being buried layer by layer in Yin Soil.

Liang Ming glared viciously at Chun Yangzi, his mouth twisting into a grin: "A Lone Yang won’t survive! Chun Yangzi, holding on till now is already your limit. Surrender, and you might save your precious life."

Many spectators couldn’t help but hold their breath.

After fighting for six days and nights, Chun Yangzi’s aura was weak, the Scriptures on his Red Gold Taoist Robe had lost their luster, and its hem was stained with Yin Soil and blood.

The tactics of the opponent had succeeded, and in this dire situation, Chun Yangzi suddenly laughed.

"Hahaha, of course, I know a Lone Yang won’t survive."

"But likewise, when Pure Yang reaches its extreme, it’s the most powerful and fierce!"

Chun Yangzi raised his hand to press his chest.

Forbidden Technique — Pure Yang Extreme Certificate!

Purge impurities, leaving only one, igniting oneself to prove Yang. Once executed, this technique burns away all impure qi, residual shadows, leaving no buffer or retreat, only the purest, fiercest Pure Yang Magical Power.

And since it’s a Forbidden Technique, naturally it comes with a heavy cost.

Once used, the Pure Yang Body acts as a furnace refining impurities, burning even one’s own flesh, life span, meridians, and so on as fuel.

Chun Yangzi staked it all!

An explosion roared within him.

Pure Yang Purity Body!

A layer of utterly pristine golden white radiance emerged from his bones and flesh, like spring water melting snow, or the scorching sun washing over mountains.

The grime on his body washed away, the Yin Soil eliminated, foul air vanished to nothing. The seven black and yellow jade marks sizzled under the scorching heat, still seared into him like seven cold chains binding the great sun.

Though his Red Gold Taoist Robe was tattered, the Three Thousand Scripture burned anew.

Three Thousand Scripture Burning Fire!

The tattered robe flapped wildly, firelight climbing up the torn edges, like a burnt-out scripture book reciting its final Chapter amidst the flames.

The Bright Heart Evil Mirror was covered with black spots, no longer usable.

The Three-hour Sun Dial Plate swiftly flew out. After six days and nights of fierce battle, its edge was scorched with burn marks, stained with an indelible blackness.

The Golden Plate lit up simultaneously at dawn, noon, and dusk.

Three Yang Bodies walked out from the plate’s glow.

The Rising Sun Body bore the gentle light of dawn, youthful in appearance, with a sense of burgeoning vigor in his eyes. He stepped forward, transforming into a ray of dawn, charging into the Cloud Gathering and Sun Supplementing Lamp.

As the Rising Sun Body leaped in, the entire lamp blazed brightly, with the Red Jade Lamp Wall cracking fine lines, returning a surge of pure Yang Qi to Chun Yangzi.

This was the final replenishment!

The Dusk Sun Body silently turned and directly lunged at the Burial Sun Jade Lord.

Its twilight gathered, like the last golden edge before the sunset behind the mountains.

Liang Ming wanted to intervene, but the Dusk Sun Body exhibited unprecedented speed at this moment, pouncing directly on the Destiny Jade.

Its figure quickly dimmed and vanished after a few breaths. But it left behind a seal, striving to delay the Destiny Jade’s power.

The Noon Sun Body strode into Chun Yangzi’s main body.

The two merged like rivers converging!

In an instant, Chun Yangzi’s momentum surged, like a furnace suddenly fueled. Golden red light patterns emerged from the depths of his flesh, like Earth Fire through stone, surfacing on his mighty physique.

The Golden Crow Ring transformed into a Golden Crow, its fifth eye opened!

Though its Spiritual Nature was exhausted, the light in its eyes remained sharp.

It opened its mouth, seizing a Red Gold Elixir Pill.

Ancestor Fire Unification Pill!

The Elixir Pill, as deep gold as aged copper, had no patterns on its surface, but a thread of Ancestor Fire quietly burned at its core.

The moment the Golden Crow Ring held it, the image of the Three-legged Golden Crow solidified unprecedentedly.

It flapped its wings and flew, charging directly at Liang Ming.

Liang Ming was greatly shocked. The Golden Crow Ring, after ingesting the Elixir Pill, made him feel as if confronting a genuine Three-legged Golden Crow.

Liang Ming felt tremendous pressure, hastily defending.

Chun Yangzi stepped forward.

Midday Shadowless Step!

No shadow lay beneath his feet, as if devoured wholly by the noonday sky. Stepping once, the stone platform beneath erupted loudly, and in the blink of an eye, his figure was upon the brink of the Yin Tombs.

Nine Yang Locking Finger rose again!

The first finger glowed golden white, scourging through the Yin Soil, sending shattered earth flying and turbid air surging.

The second finger radiated Pure Yang, boring into the ground, ruthlessly toppling the base of the first and second tombs.
